package.description: Screenshots and screen recordings, with an editor to mark them up and a library of everything you take.

en-US.description: Screenshots and screen recordings, with an editor to mark them up and a library of everything you take.
en-US.longDescription:
Press Print Screen to capture a region, a window or a screen, or record one. Captures open in an editor
with arrows, shapes, text, highlights, blur and crop, and are kept in a library on your disk. Recordings
can be cut and annotated on a timeline. PrtScr keeps itself up to date.
en-US.name: PrtScr
